invariants.rationale: Engine context is typically required for execution and is expected to be non-null.
An action must have a valid, non-empty instant time to identify the commit.
The list of keys to delete should be provided and not be null.
Deletes should operate on a non-empty list of keys. If keys is provided, it is expected to contain elements.
All keys in the list should be non-null to avoid errors during delete.
